papirfly.description:
About Papirfly

Papirfly empowers over a million users at top global brands to create, manage, and distribute marketing assets with ease. Now, we’re looking for a curious, people-first Customer Success Manager to join our London team. If you have experience in SaaS customer success or account management and are eager to grow in a high-impact, collaborative environment, this is your opportunity. You’ll mainly look after our Keepeek clients and the Keepeek side of the business, working closely with experienced teammates and big-name brands, helping customers thrive on our platform while building your own career in the fast-moving world of MarTech.

As part of Papirfly Group, we’re shaping the future of marketing technology through innovation and expertise. With over 350 team members across eight countries, we deliver solutions that meet the real-world challenges of our customers, from simplifying content creation to seamlessly managing digital assets. Combining the strengths of Papirfly, Brandpad, Keepeek, and Adgistics, we empower businesses to drive scalable growth and foster trust and loyalty among employees and customers. Fun fact: Papirfly is the Norwegian word for ‘paper plane’ reflecting our Nordic roots. Today, as a global company, we pronounce it ‘paper fly’.

Visit www.papirfly.com for more information.

An Introduction to this role

Papirfly empowers over a million users at top global brands to create, manage, and distribute marketing assets with ease. Now, we’re looking for a curious, people-first Customer Success Manager to join our London team. If you have experience in SaaS customer success or account management and are eager to grow in a high-impact, collaborative environment, this is your opportunity. You’ll work closely with experienced teammates and big-name brands, helping customers thrive on our platform while building your own career in the fast-moving world of MarTech.

In return, you’ll gain hands-on experience with a powerful platform used by leading global brands, a clear path to grow your skills in SaaS Customer Success, and ongoing support through mentoring and development opportunities. You’ll be part of a collaborative culture that values new ideas, encourages curiosity, and prioritizes real impact over job titles.

Key Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with clients, acting as a trusted partner across the full customer lifecycle, from onboarding through to renewal and expansion. Be the first point of contact for your clients and the person they turn to for advice and answers.
Renewal Readiness: Keep customers renewal-ready throughout the contract by tracking value realised, product adoption and customer health, and keeping key stakeholders aligned. Flag risk early, and loop in Account Management for pricing, contract and negotiation support on complex renewals.
Upsell & Expansion: Spot and drive upsell and cross-sell opportunities, such as extra users, modules and services, based on usage and customer goals. Lead the client conversation and bring in Account Management to scope and close larger deals.
Customer Strategy & Stakeholder Mapping: Build a customer strategy, roadmap and stakeholder map for each account, aligning Papirfly’s platform with the client’s business objectives. Keep these plans up to date so you always know who matters and what success looks like for each client.
Customer Understanding: Understand each customer’s business problems and goals, and show how our technology can solve them. Ask good questions and listen closely so your recommendations are relevant, not generic.
Product Adoption: Drive adoption of the Papirfly platform so customers get real value and achieve their goals. Spot low usage early and put a plan in place to turn it around.
Customer Engagement: Host regular engagement sessions and business reviews with clients, and track progress against their goals. Use these moments to share results, agree next steps and strengthen the relationship.
Portfolio Management: Manage a book of 25-35 clients, mainly from our customer base, depending on account size and complexity, balancing proactive account management with responsive day-to-day support. Prioritise your time across the portfolio based on client needs and risk.
Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams and directly with clients to translate their needs into actionable outcomes and keep projects running smoothly. Partner with Support, Product and Account Management to resolve issues quickly.
Feedback & Continuous Improvement: Capture and share client feedback to help improve our offering and customer experience. Bring a fresh perspective to our processes and keep looking for ways to improve how we work.

Knowledge And Experience Required

Experience in a Customer Success or Account Management role in a SaaS company, ideally 2+ years.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
Pro-activity, curiosity, and an eagerness to learn - comfortable asking questions and proposing new ideas.
High levels of organisation and confidence in managing multiple priorities and customer needs.
Fluent in French and English, with the confidence to work with clients in French.
Must be based in London and excited about working in a hybrid, collaborative environment.
Exposure to marketing teams or marketing technology platforms (not required but beneficial).

sweep.description:
Sweep is hiring a Customer Success Manager based in the UK, London, to work on our enterprise climate program software.

Professional fluency in English and French, spoken and written, is mandatory. You must be able to lead customer-facing success activities in both languages.

Ok, sounds promising. What will I be doing?

As a Customer Success Manager in the Success Team, you will help customers realise the value of Sweep throughout the post-implementation success phase.

You will own customer relationships across a mixed portfolio, helping customers connect their sustainability objectives, reporting needs, and data to durable ways of working with Sweep. You will lead strategic follow-ups, coordinate the right internal expertise, support retention and renewals, and identify appropriate growth opportunities. The role is based in London.

To be more specific, this includes:2. Retention, Renewals & Growth 📈 3. Data, Process & Product Feedback 📣4. AI-enabled Customer Success 🤖

Customer Success & Value Realisation 🤝
Own the post-implementation success phase and act as the primary point of contact throughout the customer relationship.
Run regular customer check-ins, business reviews, and executive follow-ups to review objectives, progress, feedback, risks, and next steps.
Understand customer objectives, success measures, operating context, stakeholders, and ways of working.
Drive adoption, value realisation, customer autonomy, and time-to-value by connecting customer needs to relevant Sweep capabilities.
Enable customers with relevant product updates, use cases, best practices, webinars, and self-service resources. Formal implementation and product training remain with the appropriate Delivery or Enablement teams.
Own customer health and retention plans, identify risks early, and coordinate actions to protect customer outcomes.
Lead renewal planning and, where appropriate, lead expansion conversations by understanding customer needs and demonstrating value.
Partner with Sales on pricing, proposals, and complex commercial negotiations as relevant, while maintaining ownership of the customer relationship.
Manage escalations thoughtfully, resolve friction proactively, and ensure support requests are routed, tracked, and followed through with the Care team.
Build trusted relationships with customer champions, operational stakeholders, and executives.
Develop customer advocacy opportunities, including references, testimonials, and customer stories.
Coordinate a clear handover from Implementation and maintain continuity across objectives, configuration, decisions, risks, open items, and next steps.
Share relevant customer insights with Customer Success, Growth, Product, Engineering, and other internal teams.
Use product usage, customer health, support, satisfaction, and commercial data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Track and improve customer health, product adoption, customer value, NPS, CSAT, retention, and renewal performance.
Improve Customer Success processes, playbooks, operating rhythms, and account planning practices.
Gather customer feedback, clarify and prioritise product requests, and turn recurring needs into actionable insights for Product and Engineering.
Use AI tools to analyse information, prepare customer communications, improve workflows, and support better decision-making. Sweep provides guidance, tools, and best practices to help you use AI effectively.
We are looking for candidates with hands-on experience using AI in a professional setting, together with the judgment to apply human review, data-quality checks, and professional accountability.

At Sweep, artificial intelligence is part of how we work, learn, and build. Every team member uses AI tools daily to speed up operations, improve decision making, and unlock creativity. We don’t expect you to be an expert on day one, but we do expect curiosity, a willingness to experiment, and the desire to use AI as a true partner in your work.

Whether it's analyzing information, drafting content, improving workflows, designing better employee experiences, or supporting distributed teams, you’ll use AI to work faster and smarter. We provide guidance, tools, and best practices so you can get the most out of it.

We’re looking for candidates who already have hands-on experience with AI tools in a professional setting. You should be comfortable using AI to support your daily work, enhance productivity, and create new solutions. If you naturally reach for AI to amplify what you do, you’ll feel right at home here.

That sounds just right for me. What do I need to bring?

Glad you asked. This is who we’re looking for:

Qualifications 🏆

3+ years of experience in Customer Success, account management, business development, or a related field.
Experience working in a B2B SaaS company across enterprise or mid-market accounts.
Experience managing customer relationships, renewals, account plans, or commercial conversations independently.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trust with a wide range of stakeholders.
Ability to connect customer, product, sustainability, and business needs and turn them into practical actions.
Ability to use customer data and account signals to identify risks, opportunities, and priorities.
Professional fluency in English and French, spoken and written, including customer meetings, business reviews, and difficult conversations.
Experience in, or a strong interest in, sustainability, ESG, climate data, or sustainability intelligence is a plus.

Qualities 🧠

You take ownership, raise risks early, and bring practical solutions.
You are structured, reliable, and able to manage multiple priorities across a mixed customer portfolio.
You are comfortable with ambiguity and can navigate difficult conversations constructively.
You build trust through sound judgment, clear communication, and consistent follow-through.
You enjoy sharing knowledge, collaborating across teams, and improving how Customer Success operates.
You are motivated by sustainability and care about helping organisations make better decisions with data.

Copy that. And what’s in it for me?

You will be joining an exciting young business that has the humble ambition to change the world. With a proven track record in starting companies, we’re planning to hit the ground running and have an impact fast. Joining this journey right at the beginning allows you to really help shape our path.

Our hybrid work model, with hiring focussed around our head offices in Paris, London and Montpellier, allows us to balance our personal and professional lives while staying connected and engaged with colleagues and clients.

We’re big believers in creating successful businesses that are good for everyone, including society and the planet. That’s why we have a B Corporation status.

We think this will be the ride of our lives. And maybe yours, too.

busuu.description:
Job Description

About us

Joining Busuu means being part of one of the top EdTech companies in the world, a multiple award-winner recognised for its innovation and impact in language learning.

Busuu’s vision is to empower people through languages. We are the world’s largest online community for language learning, with 120+ million registered users. We make learning a language easy by combining AI-powered courses with feedback from our global community of native speakers and lesson content designed for real life.

Busuu is part of the global Chegg family. Chegg is the leading student-first connected learning platform and a NYSE listed company.

What Does a Customer Success Manager Do At Busuu

You will be responsible for ensuring our customers' success. Ensuring clients who use Busuu will get better business results. This is achieved by understanding key client objectives and implementing Busuu engagement strategies. Renewing and expanding accounts is how you will be primarily measured so it is important that you are commercially focused. You will also be working closely with our sales and product teams.

What will you do at Busuu?

Build strong and long term relationships with our clients
Ensure our clients are maximising their use of Busuu and we are delivering against agreed goals and KPIs
Develop and deploy strategies and action plans to improve the client experience, gross/net retention and enable account growth
Successfully onboard new clients and build capabilities to help clients implement Busuu in their organisation
Work with new business and product teams to translate business needs and product requirements into new solutions for customers
Drive customer references, case studies and referrals
Identify emerging trends in the local corporate language market and build good awareness of the competitive environment.

Essential Skills & Experience

3+ years experience in Customer Success/ Client Relationship/ Account Management within a technology business and SaaS environment
French and English fluency
An entrepreneurial, solutions-focused individual, who puts clients’ needs at the core of business.
Ability to interpret then present client data to customers
Keen interest in identifying client problems and finding smart solutions
Previous experience in enterprise sized clients (Saas model)

Bonus Skills & Experience

Additional European language skills
Experience of the ed tech industry

At Busuu we want to ensure that you have access to some great benefits:

Busuu offers a great Private Health Insurance scheme
Training budget just for you, so you can learn more in your field, attend virtual conferences and events that you find interesting
We like to support our teams with their work-life balance so we offer flexible working hours and hybrid or remote model of working.
Our centrally located offices are well-equipped with free breakfast, plenty of snacks, fresh fruit.
We offer enhanced maternity and paternity leave
Staying connected as a team is very important to us, so we have lots of social activities for you to join such a team lunches, Friday socials, quarterly team, and company events

What Happens Next

We aim to have a simple and speedy hiring process and we want to make sure that we are right for you as much as the other way around.

The hiring process is as follows;

CV application review - We will review it as quickly as possible and update on the next steps
Let’s chat - Quick chat with our recruiter about your experience and the role
Test - You will be asked to prepare presentation and then present it to us in the interview
A video call - 40 min call with the hiring manager on the exercise feedback and the role
Final interview

Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. We pride ourselves on embracing our differences, whether they're cultural, racial, religious or otherwise. This means each one of us comes to work knowing that we have a voice – and a safe, judgement-free zone to speak freely.

If you like the sound of that, join us. We'd love to hear what you have to say.

easyship.description:
About Easyship:
Easyship is a leading global shipping software and API platform trusted by 100,000+ eCommerce merchants to compare couriers, automate fulfilment, and simplify cross-border shipping, taxes and duties. A top-rated Shopify Certified Technology Provider, eBay preferred fulfilment partner, and Amazon preferred multi-channel integrator, Easyship is the G2 category leader (April 2026), offering 550+ courier services worldwide. We believe in accelerating borderless commerce through innovative solutions, and we're proud that brands of all sizes from small business to enterprise trust Easyship for all their shipping needs.

Who We’re Looking For:
We are looking for an experienced Customer Success Manager to join our team and take ownership of strategic client relationships. You’ll work with some of our largest accounts, ensuring smooth onboarding, driving adoption, and uncovering growth opportunities. This role requires a mix of strategic account management, problem-solving, and strong communication skills to help clients succeed globally.

What you additionally need to know:
This is a full-time, hybrid role (3 days in office) based in London. The role follows UK hours (9:00AM–6:00PM) to support seamless cross-regional execution.

What would be you be responsible for:
Owning a portfolio of high-value accounts, fostering trust and building long-term relationships while managing onboarding, adoption, renewals, and growth.
Acting as a trusted advisor to enterprise clients, understanding their needs, strategic objectives, long term business goals and aligning them with Easyship solutions.
Proactively engaging with customers to track progress, deliver success reviews, and demonstrate value, while identifying and mitigating risks of churn.
Anticipating customer challenges and provide solutions collaborating closely with Support, Operations, and Product teams to ensure success.
Identifying and pursue expansion opportunities leading commercial discussions for upsells and renewals, and partnering with Sales to drive revenue growth.
Monitoring account health by tracking key success metrics such as Health Score, NPS, NRR, and CSAT, ensuring client satisfaction, retention, and revenue growth.
Driving process improvement identifying inefficiencies, and proposing improvements that enhance team productivity and the customer journey.
Serving as a customer advocate within Easyship, championing client needs across internal teams, and building strong external advocacy to amplify Easyship’s brand in the market with reviews, case studies and referrals.

You Might Be a Good Fit If…
You have at least 3 years prior experience in Customer Success or equivalent history of driving customer outcomes, retention and revenue growth
You have a customer-first mindset with a proven ability to build relationships
You have a strong business acumen and experience articulating value in a way that aligns with customer goals and KPIs
You have excellent communication and data storytelling skills.
You have experience identifying expansion opportunities and working with Sales teams to close them
You are proactive in setting and managing expectations with customers, ensuring alignment on goals, timelines and responsibilities
You have proven ability to manage multiple accounts and client types simultaneously

If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you.

What we bring to the table as an employer:
Generous remuneration and stock units
Comprehensive health coverage
We reimburse gym and wellness expenses so you can invest in your health
The freedom to ‘Work from Anywhere’ for 4 weeks in a year
Generous vacation policy, plus duvet days and mental health days to truly recharge

How we value inclusion in our recruitment practices:
Easyship is an equal opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions—recruiting, hiring, pay, benefits, training, promotion, leave, and separation—based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, veteran or military status, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.

kerv.description:
Please note: We are a hybrid working company and this role will require to attend Richmond (TW9) based office twice a week depending on business needs.

This is a 12 month Fixed Term Contract.

About Us

Launched in July 2020, Kerv is a next-generation ‘Customer-first, cloud-first’ provider, created to help customers achieve successful business outcomes in a new digital era. We are undergoing an exciting period of transformation and growth following the merger of five highly successful organisations.

One of those organisations is Kerv Experience who live and breathe customer engagement. Every day, we create and implement award-winning, cloud omnichannel solutions to help our customers deliver industry-leading customer experience.

About The Team

As a member of the Kerv Experience Customer Success team, you will work directly with our customers to help them achieve their business outcomes and realise value from their services. This is a 12-month fixed-term maternity cover role, taking ownership of an established portfolio of high-profile customer accounts and providing continuity throughout the customer journey. We are constantly evolving and work in a fast-paced environment, with our Customer Success Managers acting as a trusted point of contact and delivering service excellence at every touchpoint. The team is supportive, collaborative, dynamic, curious, fun and innovative, with everyone working together to deliver the best possible customer experience.

Your part to Play

  • Own a portfolio of high-profile customer accounts, driving business outcomes, customer value, satisfaction and retention.
  • Act as a trusted customer advocate and central point of contact, facilitating prompt and effective responses to queries, requests and issues.
  • Be the voice of the customer, sharing insight across the business and identifying risks, opportunities and areas for improvement.
  • Act as the escalation lead when issues remain unresolved, bringing the right teams together and maintaining clear communication through to resolution.
  • Build a deep understanding of each customer’s goals, review account data and help shape impactful strategies that support their objectives.
  • Provide meaningful customer reporting, host service and success reviews, and proactively monitor customer health, satisfaction, adoption, training needs and renewal risk.
  • Identify and support relevant adoption, cross-sell and up-sell opportunities that strengthen customer outcomes and protect Kerv’s long-term position.
  • Actively monitor customer health and lead appropriate actions and changes where required.
  • Maintain accurate customer records, engagement notes, risks, health indicators and actions within CRM and relevant internal systems.
  • Work collaboratively across Sales, Service Management, Support, Delivery and Marketing to provide a coordinated and high-quality customer experience.

All About You

  • Proven experience in a Customer Success, Customer Experience or similar customer-facing role.
  • Around three years’ experience within a SaaS, CCaaS or technology business would be advantageous.
  • ITIL certification would be beneficial.
  • Customer-focused, with excellent communication skills and the confidence to build trusted relationships with senior customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Able to think quickly, use sound judgement and remain calm when priorities change or time-sensitive issues arise.
  • A genuine team player who enjoys collaborating, sharing knowledge and stepping in to support others when needed.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and managing multiple priorities without losing attention to detail.
  • Positive, proactive and self-starting, with a can-do attitude and the confidence to take ownership through to completion.
  • Forward-thinking and methodical, with strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills and the ability to work through ambiguity.
  • Open to occasional travel to customer sites, Kerv offices and company or customer events as required.
  • Comfortable working within a hybrid model, balancing office-based and remote working.

You will live the Kerv values…

  • Think Customer First
  • Team is everything
  • Spread good vibes
  • Build future
  • Do the right thing

At Kerv, we’re building something special and we’re building it to last. We want everybody to feel valued, included and love working together. With an uncompromising pursuit of amazing employee experience, we always strive to do the right thing. We believe and will relentlessly promote and support the power of diversity, equality and belonging, through collaboration and creating exceptional solutions together.

staffr.description:
Customer Success Manager


The role at a glance

• Base salary: £30,000–£40,000

• Bonus/commission tied to client retention and account growth

• Equity / share options

• Location: Hybrid, London (1–2 days a week in the office)


About the company

We're a sales intelligence tool that helps B2B sales teams find the right accounts at the right moment. Instead of working from static lists, our clients see which companies are showing real buying signals, why each lead matters, and can reach out across email, LinkedIn and phone.


We're an ambitious team in London, and we're growing fast. Customer Success is at the heart of that growth, because our clients' results are our results. You'll be one of the first people to join the team and will help shape how we look after clients as we scale.


Life here

Things move quickly here, and everyone owns their work. You'll have the freedom to make decisions, try new approaches and see the impact of what you do straight away. It's challenging work, and it's rewarding.


We're collaborative, and there's no such thing as a bad idea. The best ideas can come from anyone on the team, and you'll play a real part in making the product even better.


We also make time to enjoy it together. When the team hits a milestone, we celebrate with a team lunch. We get together for regular socials and drinks, head out on offsites, and visit our clients in person so we truly understand the people we work for.


We're hybrid, with days in our London office, so you get time together as a team and flexibility around it.


What you'll do

You'll be the person our clients trust most at the company. From their first kickoff call onwards, you'll help them get live quickly, see real pipeline from the platform, and grow with us over time. Our clients are all over the world, so you'll work with sales teams across different markets and time zones.


• Welcome new clients. Run kickoff calls, get to know their go-to-market, and get them live and seeing results fast.

• Shape their targeting. Work with clients on who they should go after and which buying signals matter, then keep refining as results come in.

• Keep campaigns performing. Keep an eye on leads, launches and replies for each account, and step in early with ideas when something could work better.

• Help every user get value. Make sure everyone on the account is using the platform well, and coach reps who are still finding their feet.

• Celebrate results together. Run regular check-ins and quarterly reviews that show clients the impact the platform has had, and plan what's next.

• Grow your accounts. Spot when a client is ready for more leads, more seats or a bigger plan, and work with sales to make it happen.

• Be their go-to person. When a client needs help, you're the first call, and you see it through.

• Bring the customer's voice inside. Share what clients need with product and sales so the platform keeps getting better.


Who we're looking for

We care more about who you are than what's on your CV. Attitude, graft and genuine care for people will take you further here than any job title.


• Ownership. When a client has a problem, it's your problem. You see it through without being chased.

• Organised. You manage a full book of clients without dropping a follow-up or missing a deadline.

• Calm under pressure. If a client is ever unhappy, you stay steady and focus on finding the fix.

• Empathy. You genuinely care whether your clients succeed, and you take the time to understand what they need.

• Strong communication. You explain things clearly on calls and in writing, and you can hold your own with founders and sales leaders.

• Problem solving. You dig into why something isn't working instead of waiting for someone else to fix it.

• Commercial curiosity. You understand how sales teams work and you notice when a client is ready to grow.

• Drive. You put in the work consistently and you want fast career progression, and you're prepared to earn it.


Experience

• 6–12 months in a sales role (SDR, BDR, account management, account executive or similar). We're a sales tool, so you need to understand our customers' world firsthand.

• Experience working with customers or clients directly, whether in sales, account management or customer success

• Comfortable running calls and presentations with senior stakeholders

• Clear, confident communication, written and spoken

• Bonus: experience with outbound tools, CRMs or B2B SaaS


What you'll get

• £30,000–£40,000 base, plus bonus/commission tied to client retention and growth.

• Equity options. A real stake in the company you're helping to build.

• Room to grow. You'll be the 2nd hire in a CS team that's about to scale. As the team grows, you'll have every chance to grow with it, including into leadership.

• Your own clients from day one. Real relationships and real ownership, not a support queue.

• Support to do your best work. You'll learn directly from the Head of CS, alongside a team that wants you to succeed.

• Hybrid working in London. 1–2 days a week in the office with the team, and flexibility around it.

• Work from anywhere. Two weeks a year to work from wherever you like.

• Momentum. A profitable, funded company with plenty of exciting things ahead.
